name: walmart_product_chromium
description: Walmart US product page. Walmart's markup is React-rendered and rotates class names — selectors target stable data-testid/itemprop hooks, self_heal on for drift. price reads the last currency-marked number in the microdata node: the live value is rendered as 'Now $199.00', and any savings/was label precedes the current price. rating is anchored on its parentheses because the node also carries the review count ('(4.4)|44.4K ratings'), where the same digits appear twice; a whole-number rating would return null. KNOWN GAP: availability came back null on 1 of 2 live captures 2026-07-26 (measured on Camoufox, this preset's only engine before the 2026-08-27 split) and is not addressed here. ENGINE: Chromium (Playwright). WebGL identity follows this host — an AMD Radeon 780M claim under a Windows UA — via chromium_webgl_identity(); no fingerprint_profile, which the Chromium runner would accept and ignore. MEASURED 2026-08-27 (2 runs per engine, 4 runs in total on the one locale this preset has, research/preset_audit_dual_engine_2026_08_27.json): both variants returned data on 2/2 runs with price 125.0 every time, and availability filled on all four — the 2026-07-26 null above did not reproduce. PREFER THIS VARIANT: walmart_product_camoufox run 1 announced locale es-US and Walmart served the Spanish page (title '(Caja Abierta) Apple,AirPods Pro…', availability 'Agregar al carrito'), while this variant takes its locale from the proxy country and announced en-US on both runs. No value was corrupted, but a consumer matching availability == 'Add to cart' or keying a cache on the title breaks on that run with nothing in the response to explain why. The evidence is one Spanish draw in two Camoufox runs; n=2 cannot say whether that is half the time or rare. MEASURED 2026-08-28 (retest of the same twenty presets through the same harness after the five audit fixes; n=2 per locale, 92 runs, research/preset_audit_dual_engine_2026_08_28.json): 2/2 runs returned data with every declared field filled, en-US on both -- unchanged from 08-27, as expected: this variant pins its locale from geo_profile and never had the draw. Its value in this round is as the control the Camoufox twin now matches (0 of 45 Camoufox runs announced an off-table language, against 11 of 45 on 08-27).
